subject: Re: MAGNET status: benchmarks reproduced, cache invalidation bite
body:
Team,

Go/no-go for the June sweep, decided: GO.

Tereza confirms all catalogs have features and benchmarks cached as of June 8, four days ahead of the June 12 gate. And our 128-GPU vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of June 15 is confirmed, so the final sweep lands just before the June 22-24 Vulcan maintenance window. Ondrej's sweep configs are frozen tonight; no changes after that, given there is zero rerun slack.

Two decisions from Monday's review:
1. The service-readiness review moves from Jun 26 to Jun 29 (last day of window) so we have the sweep results fully examined, not just landed.
2. Scope cut: real-time streaming ingestion is out for this phase. Batch catalog updates only; Paloma documents the streaming design as a Q3 proposal instead.

Appreciate the disciplined run-up - this is what a boring, on-schedule big run should look like.

Dmitri
